About What I Do Approach Investment FAQs {{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Contact

Calm, Clear, Forward — Therapy that helps you act on what matters

I partner with adults facing anxiety, trauma, relationship strain, and life transitions. My work blends evidence-informed therapy with coaching clarity so you leave sessions with practical movement.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}
  • {{THERAPIST_NAME}}, {{LICENSE}}
  • {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}
  • Sessions by video and in-person

Core Principles I Work From

Practical Compassion

Therapy that is warm and direct — we bring curiosity to hard feelings and translate insight into behavior you can test between sessions.

Integrity & Confidentiality

Sessions are private and held to professional confidentiality. I’ll clarify boundaries, recordkeeping, and what to expect about limits to confidentiality up front.

Goal-Focused Partnership

We co-create measurable goals and check progress. If short-term work fits better than long-term therapy, I’ll say so and offer a clear pathway.

How I Work — Methods & Modalities

A blended toolkit shaped to your needs. Modalities I use include:

  • Trauma-informed CBT and exposure-based strategies
  • EMDR for targeted trauma processing
  • Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) to align values and action
  • Somatic coaching for body-based regulation
  • {{MODALITIES}}

I match methods to your goals; not every technique is used in every case. If a referral is appropriate, I’ll support that transition.

Common Concerns — Addressed

Will therapy take forever?

It depends on your goals. Many clients see meaningful shifts in 8–20 sessions when we focus on clear outcomes. I offer short-term plans when appropriate.

I’m not sure I’ll be taken seriously — what if my problems seem small?

Nothing you bring is too small. We work with what matters to you; progress often comes from attending to the small, persistent stresses.

Can I afford this?

I offer transparent fee plans and limited sliding-scale slots. See the Investment page for program options and typical session fees.

Client Reflections

"Working with {{THERAPIST_NAME}} felt strategic and human. I left sessions with tools I could use the next day." — A.
"Practical, calm, and firm when I needed direction. Therapy that respects your time and life." — M.

Starter Guide: Eight Small Steps to Reduce Daily Anxiety

Sign up and receive a concise workbook you can try this week. No pressure, just practical practices you can test between sessions.

We respect your privacy. Your contact details will only be used for this delivery and occasional updates. Crisis resources: if you are in danger, call local emergency services or a crisis line immediately.

Ready to start? A first session is a simple conversation.

About Specialties Schedule

Confidentiality note: sessions are private and records are stored according to professional standards. Limits to confidentiality include imminent risk of harm to self or others, suspected abuse of a child or vulnerable adult, and court orders.

Crisis disclaimer: If you are in crisis or at immediate risk, contact emergency services or your local crisis line. Therapy is not a replacement for emergency care.
